decisions.reason: The message's separate instruction to recreate the buttons is already represented by the candidate's message-201 MODIFY; the color-reference change requires no additional candidate-state update.
The bottom-logo instruction is already fully represented by the candidate's message-201 MODIFY, including removal of superseded logo details.
The message-201 INTRODUCE already establishes the specified Deck 1 and Deck 2 labels and their rendering reference; the color change adds no further necessary update.
The message-201 INTRODUCE already captures the back-panel design and font references, and the separate color-reference change does not alter them.
The message-201 INTRODUCE already captures the light surrounding the power button and its rendering reference; no additional color-related change is entailed.
The source refers to lighting around the power button, not the independently specified LED lighting around the bowls.
The source does not change the machine placard's wording, position, duplication, or viewing orientations.
Recreating the general colors and buttons does not necessarily change the separately specified cursive K markings or their beige color.
The source does not mention or alter the measurement-style markings around the bowls.
The aesthetic color reference for the machine and base does not change the platform's clearance, height, footprint, or cup-support behavior.
The source's aesthetic instructions do not change the spout's geometry, material, orientation, mounting location, or pour direction.
The aesthetic reproduction instruction does not necessarily revise the component BOM or select any additional component.
